title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Special-Order Part Release Payment and Deposit
content:
## Parts desk terms

**1. Release payment.** A special-order part on a call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls is ordered only when the customer has paid, in person, the release payment for it. The release payment is the visit balance of the call together with the special-order deposit.

**2. What falls due when.** On a call whose approved repair waits for a special-order part, the repair's parts and labor lines, net of their member repair discounts, fall due when the repair is performed on the return visit. Everything else on the invoice is the visit balance, due now.

**3. Visit balance.** The visit balance is worked out from the invoice lines. Take the call's charge lines, less its discount, coverage-credit and payment lines, plus its refund lines, and set aside the repair's parts and labor lines and their member repair discounts. The visit balance is never less than zero.

**4. Deposit rate.** The deposit rate is the call class's special-order parts deposit percentage, as listed on the class rate card.

**5. Deposit.** The special-order deposit is the repair's parts amount as billed, before any discount, multiplied by the deposit rate and rounded once to the cent half up. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded up to the higher cent; for this purpose an amount within 1e-09 of a dollar below the half cent counts as exactly halfway.

**6. Amount.** The release payment is the visit balance plus the special-order deposit.

## Worked example (hypothetical Standard Service Call, deposit rate 50 percent)

| Invoice lines | Amount | In the visit balance |
|---|---|---|
| Diagnostic fee | $89.00 | Yes |
| Repair parts, control board replace | $386.00 | Set aside |
| Repair labor, control board replace | $289.00 | Set aside |
| Payment toward the diagnostic fee | less $40.00 | Yes |
| Visit balance | $49.00 | — |
| Special-order deposit: $386.00 multiplied by 50 percent | $193.00 | — |
| Release payment | $49.00 and $193.00, which is $242.00 | — |

If the customer had already paid $120.00 toward the call, the lines outside the repair would come to less than zero, and the visit balance would be $0.00. The release payment would then be the deposit of $193.00 alone.
